title: Schneider Electric buys 75% of liquid-cooling maker Motivair for $850M

sources.quote: Under the terms of the transaction, Schneider Electric will acquire an initial 75 percent controlling interest in the equity of Motivair for $850 million in cash.
The $850 million purchase price involves 75% of Motivair.

explain: Schneider Electric paid $850 million in cash for 75% of Motivair, a Buffalo, New York maker of liquid cooling equipment for supercomputers and AI servers, and plans to buy the remaining 25% in 2028. The deal closed in early 2025.
